facts.text: Zadún sits in Puerto Los Cabos, a quiet enclave near San José del Cabo.
facts.excerpt: Zadún sits in Puerto Los Cabos, a quiet enclave just minutes from the artistic community of San José del Cabo and far from Cabo San Lucas’ more party-centric scene.

facts.text: Accommodations are suites and full residences, all with plunge pools and butler service.
facts.excerpt: offering spacious suites and full residences, all with plunge pools and highly personalized butler service.

facts.text: Most guest rooms, suites, villa and residences face the Sea of Cortez, with terraces and private plunge pools.
facts.excerpt: The majority of Zadún’s 87 guest rooms, 27 suites, villa, and residences face the Sea of Cortez, with terraces that frame the view and private plunge pools.

facts.text: Zadún is part of Ritz-Carlton's Reserve collection, whose properties are meant to feel like private estates, and guests are assigned personal tosoani (dream keepers).
facts.excerpt: Reserve properties are meant to feel more like private estates than hotels, with guests receiving personal tosoani (“dream keepers”)

facts.text: El Barrio serves Mexican breakfasts and street-food-inspired lunches.
facts.excerpt: head to El Barrio, which bursts with color, designed to resemble lively street vendors as it serves up bold Mexican breakfasts and street-food-inspired lunches

facts.text: Equis has an omakase-style raw bar.
facts.excerpt: for something lighter, visit the omakase-style raw bar at Equis.

facts.text: The Candil bar is in the resort's lighthouse and has an agave program, with a signature Desert Moon cocktail of mezcal, prickly pear and a hint of chili.
facts.excerpt: the Candil bar, located in the resort’s “lighthouse,” steals evenings with its agave program, one of the best in Los Cabos, with the signature Desert Moon cocktail featuring mezcal, prickly pear, and a hint of chili

facts.text: Sensei is a 29,000-square-foot spa devoted to multisensory journeys.
facts.excerpt: Sensei, a 29,000-square-foot spa devoted to multisensory journeys.

facts.text: Whales are visible from guest rooms during migration season.
facts.excerpt: Its perch also makes it a prime spot for whale watching during migration season, with whales easily visible in the distance from guest rooms.

facts.text: The resort's three nine-hole golf courses overlook the Sea of Cortez and were designed by Greg Norman and Jack Nicklaus.
facts.excerpt: The resort’s three nine-hole courses overlook the Sea of Cortez and were designed by Greg Norman and Jack Nicklaus.

facts.text: The multi-bedroom residences give children space, and the resort runs activities through the Ritz-Carlton Ambassadors of the Environment program.
facts.excerpt: The multi-bedroom residences provide space for kids to spread out, and the resort offers fun and educational activities through the Ritz-Carlton’s renowned Ambassadors of the Environment program.

facts.text: The beach at Zadún is not swimmable because of a steep drop-off and strong currents.
facts.excerpt: The beach at Zadún isn’t swimmable—the drop-off is steep and currents are strong.

facts.text: The property uses renewable energy sources and has electric vehicle charging stations and electric golf carts.
facts.excerpt: It uses renewable energy sources and electric vehicle charging stations for resident cars and the electric golf carts that transport guests around the property.

facts.text: The majority of the resort meets ADA standards with ramps and wheelchair-friendly pathways.
facts.excerpt: the majority of the resort meets ADA standards with ramps and wheelchair-friendly pathways.
